features: Ergonomic design: It is ergonomically designed for a long working duration even when it is used on a mouse pad, plain table, or wooden surface.
DPI level: The ZEB-Dash Pro wireless mouse has a dedicated 3-level DPI switch and can operate at a DPI level of up to 1600 for smooth cursor movements with reliably utmost precision.
Buttons: The 4 buttons- Right, Left, and Middle(scroll), dedicated DPI switch can boost your productivity.
Power-saving mode: When not in use, the mouse transcends to power-saving mode.
Power button: The mouse comes with a Power button for the ON and OFF functions when in use and otherwise.
